rulings.D-13: Operator-owned concrete material component transport/library architecture choice before PK-7; lead prepares reviewable artifacts. Only an ABI- and scope-preserving route is admissible. No choice is made by v6.
rulings.N-06: Operator custody at deployment for re-provisioning native_sha256 against the installed and loaded reviewed library; mismatch refusal retained. An old-library hold gives no consolidated-candidate acceptance.
rulings.N-01: Lead-owned strict warning obligation. Confirming representation clauses preserve C1-C8 and require E1-E6. Nonconfirming material ABI change separately needs the original operator decision and does not authorize weakening.

approval_gates: The carried rules reserve material API/ABI/owner-policy, operator custody, deployment architecture and the original production/publication actions. Pinning or changing an implementation file creates no new approval gate solely because it is pinned; reviewed deltas and recomputation of effective pins are required by HANDOFF acceptance sequence item 1. The earlier draft-PR authorization is not rewritten by this design review.
